ghi_chu: Mau cat tu anh nen Huyen Van Quan (toa do pixel [x,y,w,h]). Chon vung dong nhat: khong co mep tuong/bac/sinh, khong co pixel trong suot. Bake lat guong + tron 2 lop lech de giau duong noi. Dat: anh goc chi co mang dat nho -> 'recolor' = do sang cua co (tile 'grass') anh xa len bang mau lay tu mang dat that (vung palette).

grass.ghi_chu: o lat lien 128 px (khong lat guong), chon bien the theo hash(o, seed), wrap modulo

leaflitter.ghi_chu: nhu grass, bo leaflitter (la rung kho, Hau Son)

cobble.ghi_chu: da lat san tren (x330-670, y40-280), tranh vet do o dinh (y<20) va mep

slab.ghi_chu: dai da phien giua san (x458-534, y380-710), giua hai thanh thang

grass_mirror.ghi_chu: ban cu (lat guong) cua grass; forest_shade/dirt_recolor dua tren no. Khong khu nao dung neu khong goi ten

forest_shade.ghi_chu: o lat lien 128 (khong lat guong), chon bien the theo hash(o, seed)

dirt_recolor.ghi_chu: dat nau: mang dat that o goc duoi-trai nen (x246-306, y978-1023)
